audit.whatIsWrong: Three flagged interactions were absent from the page. Zaahen heals from both his Q and his R with no anti-heal call anywhere; his E deals percent-health damage so armour stacking misprices the trade; and his Q is an auto-attack reset, so the page never tells the player what the commit tell is. dosFull[2].d, dontsFull[0].d and dontsFull[1].d were all generic filler.
audit.why: Q is 10/9/8/7/6s with heal and autoReset flags and a recast that knocks up. E is 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s, a dash flagged percentHealth. R is 110/95/80s and heals off damage dealt. Together those decide every extended trade and the page said none of it.
audit.corrected: dosFull[2].d now calls Grievous Wounds against both heals; dontsFull[0].d states the auto-reset wind-up tell; dontsFull[1].d states that his dash scales with health so armour alone reads the trade wrong.
sources: enemyKit Q, E, R flags and cooldowns
